description: This file defines the GenericEngineFactory class responsible for creating and managing instances of GenericEngine based on engine names. It includes methods for retrieving engines, utilizing reflection to instantiate engine classes dynamically, and caching engine instances. The class interacts with configuration utilities and handles exceptions related to configuration and instantiation.

classes.name: GenericEngineFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and caching instances of GenericEngine based on engine names, using reflection and configuration utilities.

methods.name: GenericEngineFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with a ServiceDispatcher and prepares the engine cache.

methods.name: getGenericEngine
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericEngine instance for the given engine name, loading and instantiating it via reflection if necessary, with thread-safe caching.
